# ARI Physical Therapy

> Independent outpatient physical therapy clinic in Bakersfield, California. Every visit is one-on-one with a licensed physical therapist. Care for orthopedic injuries, sports injuries, post-surgical rehab, chronic pain, pelvic floor therapy (women), pediatric therapy, and prenatal/postpartum care.

## Clinic facts

- Address: 8200 Stockdale Hwy, Suite B2, Bakersfield, CA 93311 (same shopping center as Trader Joe's)
- Phone: (661) 282-8584
- Fax: (661) 727-0005
- Email: contactus@ariptcare.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM
- Insurance: most private insurance plans and Medicare. Call to verify benefits.
- Referrals: In California, patients can see a physical therapist without a physician referral for up to 12 visits or 45 days, whichever comes first. Some insurance plans still require a referral.
- Visit length: initial evaluation 45–60 minutes; follow-up visits usually 30–45 minutes.
- In-person care only (no telehealth).
- Languages: English, Spanish, Hindi.
- Cancellations: 24 hours' notice requested.

## Clinic director

- Deepa Konnur, PT, MPT, OCS, Founder & Clinic Director. Board-certified Orthopedic Certified Specialist (American Board of Physical Therapy Specialties). Orthopedic Physical Therapy Residency, University of Southern California. Master of Physical Therapy, Loma Linda University. Former Spine Clinical Specialist PT at Kaiser Permanente. Postgraduate pelvic rehabilitation training, Herman & Wallace Pelvic Rehabilitation Institute. More than 15 years of outpatient experience.
